entities.summary: Ayat Khadoura was a Palestinian freelance journalist, podcaster and an activist on Instagram. She was killed during the Gaza genocide, along with members of her family, when an Israeli strike targeted her home in Beit Lahia on the 20th of November 2023. Over 200 journalists and media workers have been killed since Israel's war on Gaza began on October 7, 2023.
